headline: Weathered Expanse Split Three Ways; Wardens Add Ground at Linn Mercy
war_summary: The ledger has been rewritten in several districts since the previous edition. The Weathered Expanse, still the busiest ground on the board, now stands three works Warden, three Colonial and three unclaimed, the unclaimed tally cut from five; fifty-three actions were logged in the past day, with Wightwalk, Crow's Nest and Shattered Advance drawing the heaviest traffic. The Nevish Line has swung from a six-to-two Colonial advantage to four Colonial works, three Warden and one unclaimed, running among the war's heaviest hourly tolls and carrying eleven actions in six hours, the latest at this packet's cutoff. Linn Mercy likewise tightened, the Wardens rising to three works against seven Colonial and one unclaimed, with Lathair the hottest single position on the map. Mooring County is now entirely Warden, twelve works, after the last Colonial holding there was erased, though The Wind Hills still recorded twenty actions in the day. Stonecradle stirred with eight actions in six hours about World's End and The Reach; Marban Hollow has gone quiet since the small hours, and Callahan's Passage continues to cool. The map remains overwhelmingly Colonial, with Warden strength massed in the north and west.
